_source: Generated from pivota-backend at commit d4f99ae90: services.market_registry.served_markets() (config/market_registry.json, status served) x services.region_pricing.pricing_currency_for_region, sorted -- the exact pairs the backend renders into CRAWL_OFFER_SERVED_MARKET_SQL. Only the served pairs are copied, not the whole registry. This repo has no generated registry copy yet (src/markets/market_registry.generated.json, from the backend scripts/generate_market_registry_json.py); the drift test reads that file instead once it exists. Re-generate from the backend, never hand-edit.
